data.title: Barclays, Lone Star Show Early Interest in Metro Bank Sale
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Metro Bank Holdings Plc is attracting early takeover interest from Barclays Plc and Lone Star after putting itself up for sale, people familiar with the matter said.

data.title: Ethena Launches on Stellar Network, With USDe and sUSDe Available
data.description: Ethena has launched on the Stellar network, where USDe and sUSDe are available. According to Foresight News, Ethena said in a post on X that users can bridge USDe, sUSDe, and ENA to Stellar through Stargate.

data.title: Variational Hints $110 Million Financing Was Not Its Previewed Strategic Partnership
data.description: Variational team members said more details were forthcoming after community members asked whether the project’s recently completed $110 million financing was the “major strategic partnership” it previewed in September. According to Odaily, Variational said in late September, when it disclosed its tokenomics, that the partnership had changed the project’s development path, pushing its TGE schedule to the fourth quarter and extending its points program through the TGE.

data.title: UBS: UK Seen as Relative Standout as European Markets Face Pressure
data.description: According to Jin10, UBS Global Wealth Management favors sterling and UK government bonds, saying Britain's political stability and efforts to control spending give it an advantage over most eurozone countries. Among the G10 currencies it monitors, UBS ranks sterling as its top pick, citing its yield advantage over the euro, Swiss franc and yen. The institution also favors UK government bonds in the short to medium term, expecting the Bank of England to raise rates less than markets anticipate. UBS macro strategist Dean Turner said the UK could be the best performer in a region where the overall environment is not ideal in 2027.

data.title: UBS Wealth Bets on Pound and Gilts as UK Outshines Much of Euro Area
data.description: UBS Global Wealth Management is betting on gains for the pound and UK gilts, citing Britain’s political stability and efforts to curb spending as advantages over much of the euro area, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Duan Yongping: Good Companies Need Not Go Public; ByteDance’s $600 Billion Valuation Interests Me
data.description:
Investor Duan Yongping said he would be interested in ByteDance at its estimated $600 billion valuation, despite the company apparently having no plans to go public.

According to Odaily, Duan made the comments today while answering a user on his Xueqiu account, describing ByteDance as a strong company and an example of why good companies do not necessarily need to list.

data.title: Interlace Showcases Stablecoin Payments and Global Card Issuance at SFF 2026
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Interlace showcased its stablecoin payment and global card issuance capabilities at the Singapore FinTech Festival 2026, held November 18–20, and set up a booth at the main venue. The platform provides card issuance, payments and fund settlement infrastructure through APIs and white-label solutions, and is exploring payment controls, transaction security and traceability for AI agents. Interlace has issued more than 10 million cards and serves over 20,000 business clients.

data.title: Address Sells All DCTY at a $162,800 Loss
data.description: An address sold all its DCTY for $49,200, taking a loss of $162,800, or 75.69%. According to Odaily, Lookonchain said the address had bought the tokens for $214,700 and sold them 20 minutes before the report. The address traded 10 tokens across 10 transactions, all at a loss, with cumulative losses of $192,500.

data.title: STOCKS | South Korean Chip Stocks Plunge as Market Hits a 10-Month Low
data.description:
According to Jin10, South Korean stocks fell more than 5% on Friday to their lowest close in 10 months, weighed down by overnight losses in U.S. technology shares and weakness in chip stocks. The KOSPI fell 267.93 points, or 5.21%, to close at 4,869.96, its lowest closing level since January 16. During the session, the index triggered its fourth sidecar trading halt this month, pausing algorithmic trading for five minutes.

iM Securities analyst Kim Joon-young said a strong market rebound would be difficult to expect unless the narrative around AI-related themes changes. Kim said investor confidence in the AI industry remained fragile and that there were no new short-term catalysts following Anthropic's IPO. He also said the index had fallen below a technical support level, making defensive trading inevitable in the near term.

Samsung Electronics fell 7.01%, while SK Hynix dropped 5.92%. Foreign investors were net sellers of stocks worth 1.1 trillion won, or about $823.23 million.

data.title: UK Retail Sales Rebound as Shoppers Stock Up on Emergency Supplies
data.description: UK retail sales unexpectedly rose last month, boosted by government warnings urging people to stock up on canned food and other essentials, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: UK October Budget Deficit Comes in Below Forecast
data.description: Britain borrowed less than forecast in October, as a resilient economy helped offset spending pressures from rising inflation, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Dario Amodei: Anthropic Will Pace AI Deployment by Safety, Not Pressure, After IPO
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said the company will train and deploy AI systems at the pace needed to build confidence in their safety and keep them under human control, rather than yield to commercial or political pressure. Discussing Anthropic’s initial public offering, he said the listing strengthened the company’s finances and its resolve to make the right choices.

Amodei said he and his co-founders started Anthropic believing powerful technology should benefit humanity. He sees potential for AI working with people to compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade, though he noted that results remain early and experiments and clinical trials take time. AI could accelerate those processes.

He said customers are using AI to support economic growth, help people escape poverty, protect democracy and free societies, and improve public services. He also cited risks including misuse by individuals or countries, economic disruption, and loss of control over AI systems, saying these outcomes depend on the choices made by developers. Anthropic has worked on biological and cyber safeguards, alignment training and testing, and methods to examine models’ internal processes and guide their behavior.

Amodei described building a successful company while making sound safety choices as “upward competition,” intended to improve the industry regardless of whether Anthropic is leading at any given time.

data.title: UK Core Retail Sales Rate at 0.9% in October vs. -0.10% Forecast; Prior Reading Revised to -0.9% from -0.70%
data.description: According to Jin10, the UK's seasonally adjusted core retail sales rate was 0.9% month over month in October, compared with expectations of -0.10%; the previous reading was revised from -0.70% to -0.9%.

data.title: UK October Public Sector Net Borrowing Comes in at £17.036 Billion, Below £18 Billion Forecast
data.description: According to Jin10, UK public sector net borrowing was £17.036 billion in October, below expectations of £18 billion; the previous figure was revised from £24.52 billion to £22.881 billion.

data.title: The Kobeissi Letter Says Tech Bear Market Could Be Best Buying Opportunity in Nearly a Decade
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing The Kobeissi Letter, the current tech stock bear market could ultimately be remembered as the best buying opportunity in nearly a decade. The firm said key parts of the market look extremely cheap unless investors believe AI has no value and its revolution is over. It also expects Democrats to be more supportive of AI than anticipated, Nvidia to weather its leadership crisis, and concerns about capital spending and free cash flow to prove excessive.

The Kobeissi Letter said market sentiment feels as though investors have just lived through another 2008, even as S&P 500 earnings are growing 32%. It added that sentiment is sharply polarized toward bubble narratives and that fear creates investors’ greatest opportunities.

data.title: 0x7F49 Buys and Sells ETH in Four Transactions
data.description: Wallet 0x7F49 made a series of ETH purchases and sales across four operations. According to Odaily, Lookonchain reported that the address sold 3,676 ETH at $2,296.30 on March 16 for $8.44 million, then bought 4,851 ETH at $1,670 on June 5 for $8.10 million. It also sold a total of 7,693 ETH at $2,315.60 on August 20 and October 26 for $17.81 million, and bought 2,879 ETH at $1,736.50 today for $5 million.

data.title: BlackRock Bitcoin Fund Records Largest Daily Outflow as Selloff Persists
data.description: BlackRock Inc.’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund recorded its largest daily withdrawal as investors pulled money from the asset amid a broader selloff across risk assets. According to Bloomberg, the withdrawal was the fund’s largest daily outflow.

data.title: Shoprite Seeks to End Christo Wiese’s Dual-Class Share Structure
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Shoprite Holdings Ltd. moved to dismantle a 25-year-old structure that gives billionaire Christo Wiese voting rights disproportionate to his economic interest in Africa’s biggest supermarket retailer.

data.title: UBS Downgrades Deutsche Börse to Sell, Citing Rich Valuation After 49% Rally
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, UBS cut its rating on Deutsche Börse to Sell from Neutral on November 20, while raising its price target to €300 from €265, an increase of about 13%. UBS said the shares had gained 49% this year and were overvalued; its new target implies about 8% downside.

Deutsche Börse has outperformed the broader market by 34 percentage points this year, making it the best-performing diversified financial company covered by UBS in Europe. Its forward price-to-earnings ratio rose to 24 from 19 at the end of 2025, putting it in the top 10% of its historical range. UBS said that over the past nine years, when the valuation reached this level, the shares underperformed the market by an average of 20% over the following 12 months. UBS said the valuation remained difficult to justify even after accounting for the proposed acquisition of Allfunds and its expected earnings-per-share contribution.

UBS expects the boost from elevated trading activity to fade. Revenue-weighted trading volumes at Deutsche Börse rose 19% to 20% year over year in September and October, but volumes across several product categories returned to normal in November, and interest-rate futures trading quickly retreated after a brief surge. UBS forecasts trading and clearing revenue growth to slow from 13% in 2026 to 4% in 2027, and group revenue growth to ease from 11% to 5%. It said some of this year's volume growth was cyclical and that a higher comparison base would weigh on 2027 growth.

After the third-quarter results, UBS raised its 2027 and 2028 earnings-per-share forecasts by 2% each, to €13.81 and €15.30, respectively, citing improved revenue expectations for trading and clearing. UBS said Deutsche Börse had outperformed over the past two months while European bank stocks were relatively weak, consistent with their historical inverse relationship. It expects unwinding of related positions to put pressure on the shares and valuation in the coming months. UBS's bull- and bear-case targets are €375 and €240, implying about 16% upside and 26% downside, respectively, against the November 18 closing price.

data.title: SlowMist Reports Critical Vulnerability in Oracle MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing SlowMist, Oracle MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster are affected by critical vulnerability CVE-2026-114952, which has a CVSS score of 9.1. The flaw affects the Client programs component and could allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to compromise affected systems.

Affected MySQL Server versions are 8.4.0 to 8.4.13, 9.7.0 to 9.7.4, and 26.1. Affected MySQL Cluster versions are 8.0 to 8.50, 8.4.0 to 8.4.13, 9.7.0 to 9.7.4, and 26.1. Successful exploitation could enable unauthorized access to sensitive information and the modification or deletion of critical data. Users should install the latest security patches, restrict unnecessary network exposure, and monitor for suspicious database activity.
